rules.boundary_rules: Boundaries often decide the single-storey question. Running too close to the fence can turn a compliant-looking footprint into an overbearing or daylight-loss problem.
rules.roof_rules: Keep the roof subordinate to the existing dwelling and avoid balconies or raised platforms. Lean-to and low-pitch forms are often easier to keep within the height limits than tall gables near a boundary.
rules.materials_rules: Match the wall, roof and joinery finishes closely to the existing house so the extension reads as a straightforward addition rather than a separate volume.
